title: Prescription lock boxes at Massachusetts pharmacies
rule_summary: A Massachusetts pharmacy registered to dispense Schedule II, III, IV or V prescription drugs must make prescription lock boxes available for sale at each store location and display the statutorily described notice on or near the pharmacy counter.
exam_relevance: Tests a Massachusetts pharmacy-operation requirement that is separate from controlled-substance storage inside the pharmacy.
exceptions: The statutory definition excludes certain institutional settings as provided in §21B.
common_confusions: Treating patient lock-box availability as optional counseling rather than a store-level statutory requirement.
verification_notes: Current official primary or official agency source checked on 2026-08-14.
